digest.component_or_area: documentation: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md close workflow
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit; the actual implementation scans all history reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status via git log with no ref argument
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, but the docs present it as unconditional
The --ref flag, which retargets completion verification and signature to a specified commit, is documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md but never mentioned in AGENTS.md
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but the docs misattribute it to the precheck
A referencing commit for the ticket or any of its transitive descendants satisfies the precheck, not just the ticket itself
